name: 日常英语
description: 日常口语主题分类词汇，按主题分关卡（称呼/数字/颜色/食物…）（来源：FunctionFun/English-Words 日常分类高频词）

words.example: [as form of address] Aw, Mom, why can't I go?  哦，妈妈，为甚么我不能去？

words.meaning: n. 爸爸；爹爹；n. (Dad)人名；(孟、巴基、阿富)达德；(泰)达
words.example: It was lovely to see your mum and dad at the school concert last night.  很高兴昨天晚上在学校音乐会上见到你爸妈。
Grandma tells us stories every night.  奶奶每晚给我们讲故事。
My grandpa takes a walk after dinner.  爷爷晚饭后去散步。
I've got several uncles and aunts.  我有几个叔叔和姑姑。
Auntie Camille  卡米尔姑妈
Do you have any brothers and sisters?  你有兄弟姐妹吗？
Sophie and Emily are sisters.  苏菲和艾蜜莉是姐妹。
My brother's wife and I both had babies around the same time, so the cousins are very close in age.  我嫂子和我差不多同时生了孩子，因此这对表兄妹年纪相若。
She's my best/oldest/closest friend - we've known each other since we were five.  她是我最要好／交情最久／最亲密的朋友——我们五岁的时候就认识了。
Our teacher is very patient with us.  我们的老师对我们很有耐心。
The doctor prescribed some pills.  医生开了一些药。
He worked as a nurse in a psychiatric hospital.  他在精神病院当护士。
She was the boss of a large international company.  她是一家大型跨国公司的老板。
We're entertaining some colleagues of Ben's tonight.  今晚我们要招待本的几位同事。UK noun countable
My neighbor waters my plants when I travel.  我旅行时邻居帮我浇花。
My mother always warned me not to talk to strangers.  我母亲总是告诫我不要和陌生人讲话。
Would you like to see the menu, sir?  您要看看菜单吗，先生?
[as form of address] May I carry your cases for you, Madam?  需要帮您提箱子吗，夫人？
You've got three bags and I've only got one.  你有3个袋子，我只有1个。
They've got two houses.  他们有两幢房子。
I've got three sisters.  我有三个姐妹。
Most animals have four legs.  大多数动物都有四条腿。
Five, four, three, two, one, blast-off!  五，四，三，二，一，点火！
Look for a bus with a number six on the front of it.  找一辆前面有数字六的公车。
The restaurant opens for dinner at seven o'clock.  餐厅在七点钟开门供应晚餐。
She was eight years old when her family moved here.  八岁那年，她家搬到了这里。
The birthday girl was wearing a badge with a nine on it.  过生日的女孩戴着一个上面有9字的徽章。
We have hired a minibus to take ten people to the party on Friday.  我们租了一辆小巴士在星期五带十个人去参加聚会。
There are eleven girls in my class and fifteen boys.  我班上有11个女生和15个男生。noun countable [+ sing/pl verb]
a twelve-seater minibus  12座的小巴
Some people think that thirteen is an unlucky number.  一些人认为十三是个不吉利的数字。
Her baby is fourteen months old.  她的孩子14个月大了。
"How many books were returned?" "Fifteen (books)."  “还回了多少本书？”“15本。”
We've got sixteen (people) coming for lunch.  我们有16个人来吃午饭。
Is that a seventeen on the front of that bus?  那辆公车的前面是不是写着17？
an eighteen-storey building  一座十八层建筑物
Simson, aged nineteen, was convicted on two charges of burglary.  19岁的西姆森被判两项盗窃罪罪成。
space for twenty people  可容纳20个人的空间
She got married when she was thirty (years old).  她三十岁时结婚的。
He looks about forty.  他看上去40岁上下。
"How fast were they driving?" "They were doing fifty (miles an hour)."  “他们当时的车速有多快？”“他们的时速达到了50英里。”
There are sixty (people) coming to the wedding.  有60人来参加婚礼。noun
This house was built seventy years ago.  这栋房子建于70年前。
They've invited eighty (guests) to the wedding.  他们邀请了80个（客）人参加他们的婚礼。
Ninety percent of the people surveyed were in favour.  90%的被访者表示赞成。UK number
We've driven a/one hundred miles in the last two hours.  这两个小时我们已经开了100英哩了。
I've got a thousand things to do before we go on holiday.  我们去渡假前，我还有很多事情要做。
She got eight million dollars for appearing in that film.  她出演那部电影拿到了800万美元的片酬。
This is my first visit to New York.  这是我第一次到纽约。
Is Brian her first or second child?  布莱恩是她的第一个还是第二个孩子？
She came third in the exam.  她在考试中得了第三名。UK ordinal number
My birthday is on the fourth of December.  我的生日是12月4日。
Tomorrow is the fifth (of September).  明天是（9月）5号。ordinal number
The dress was bright red.  这件连衣裙是鲜红色的。
Her hands were blue with cold (= slightly blue because of the cold).  她的手冻得发青。adjective
He used to be a Liberal, but now he's a Green.  他以前是自由党成员，但是现在加入绿党了。
It was early autumn and the leaves were turning yellow.  正值初秋时节，树叶开始转黄。
The future looked black.  未来希望渺茫。
He's white-haired now.  他现在头发都已经白了。
The sky turned gray before the storm.  暴风雨来临前天空变成了灰色。
Both my parents have curly brown hair.  我的父母都有一头棕色的鬈发。verb intransitive or transitive
Have you been in the sun? Your nose is a bit pink.  你晒太阳了吗？你的鼻子有点发红。adjective
Despite occasional patches of purple prose , the book is mostly clear and incisive.  这本书尽管偶尔有几段词藻华丽的文句，但总体来讲文风简洁明了。UK noun countable or uncountable
The setting sun filled the sky with a deep orange glow.  落日的余晖将天空染成了橙红色。UK noun countable or uncountable
He's running so well, surely he'll take the gold.  他跑得很出色，肯定能拿金牌UK adjective
We gave Alison and Tom a dish made of solid silver as a wedding present.  我们送给爱丽森和汤姆一个纯银盘子作为结婚礼物。

words.meaning: n. 米黄色；adj. 浅褐色的；米黄色的；枯燥乏味的；n. (Beige)人名；(法)贝热
words.example: She painted the walls beige.  她把墙刷成了米色。
My brother is an officer in the Navy.  我兄弟是海军军官。
He held out an olive branch to the opposition by releasing 42 political prisoners.  他释放了42名政治犯，以此向反对派表达了和解的愿望。
The logo uses cyan and white.  这个标志用了青色和白色。

words.meaning: n./a.紫红色(的)；n.紫红色的染料
words.example: The printer needs magenta ink.  打印机需要品红色墨水。
Do you prefer brown rice or white rice?  你喜欢吃糙米还是精米？
egg/rice noodles  鸡蛋面／米粉
This bread is fresh/stale.  这面包是新鲜的／变味了。
How do you like your eggs - fried or boiled?  鸡蛋你想怎样吃？是吃煎的还是煮的？
Breast/Mother's milk is the best nourishment for a baby.  母乳是婴儿最好的营养品。
It was a nicely written article and quite amusing but there wasn't much meat to it.  这是篇文笔优美又饶有趣味的文章，但没甚么实质内容。noun
We're having roast/fried chicken for dinner.  晚饭我们吃烤鸡／炸鸡。noun
Several large fish live in the pond.  池塘里有几条大鱼。
The spaghetti sauce is made with UK minced / US ground beef.  这种意粉的调味汁是用牛肉碎做成的。
a pork chop  猪排
The potato is the most popular vegetable in Britain.  在英国，马铃薯是最受欢迎的蔬菜。
Apricots are the one fruit I don't like.  水果中只有杏子是我不爱吃的。
His youngest daughter was the apple of his eye.  他的小女儿是他的心肝宝贝。noun countable or uncountable
a bunch of bananas  一串香蕉
black/white/red/green grapes  紫／白／红／绿葡萄
We shared a watermelon in summer.  夏天我们一起吃西瓜。
boiled/roasted/fried potatoes  煮／烤／炸马铃薯
Tomato soup is my favorite.  番茄汤是我的最爱。
Sometimes I just have to resort to the carrot and stick approach with my children.  有时候我只能对我的孩子采取软硬兼施的办法。
Toss (= Mix) the salad with a vinaigrette dressing.  用油醋酱调味料拌沙拉。
Would you like a bowl of soup?  你要不要来碗汤？noun countable or uncountable
Would you get some coffee when you go shopping?  你去买东西时买点咖啡好吗？
I'd love a cup of tea, please.  请给我来一杯茶。
Fry the meat first to seal in the juices.  先把肉煎一煎锁住肉汁。noun
I'd like a Coke with ice, please.  请给我一杯加冰可乐。

words.meaning: n. 比萨饼（一种涂有乳酪和番茄酱的意大利式有馅烘饼）；n. (Pizza)人名；(意)皮扎
words.example: a slice of pizza  一块比萨
He ate a hamburger for lunch.  他午餐吃了一个汉堡包。
On the train I was sandwiched between two very large men.  在火车上，我被两个壮汉夹在中间。verb
Don't write in (= using a) pen, or you won't be able to rub out any mistakes you make.  不要用钢笔写，否则写错就擦不掉了。noun countable
He sat with his pencil poised , ready to take notes.  他坐着，手里拿着铅笔准备写笔记。
She wrote a book on car maintenance.  她写了一本关于汽车保养的书。
She was jotting things down in a little notebook.  她在一个小笔记本上匆匆记了些东西。UK noun countable
Just then, his mobile phone rang.  就在那时，他的手机响了。
All our customer orders are handled by computer.  我们所有顾客的订单都是用电脑来处理的。
I take my laptop to the cafe.  我带着笔记本电脑去咖啡馆。
He spent the entire afternoon watching a cricket match.  他整个下午都在看一场板球比赛。
I can't read without my glasses.  不戴眼镜我看不清。
Don't eat that whole bag of (= the amount the bag contains) sweets at once.  不要一次就把整袋糖吃完。
He pulled out a big fat wallet stuffed with bank notes.  他掏出一个塞满钞票的鼓鼓囊囊的大钱包。    Compare purse     (also document wallet)
The song changes key halfway through.  歌曲在中间部分调子变了。
Sheila won this cup in the school squash championship.  这奖杯是希拉参加学校的壁球锦标赛获得的。
There's still lots of food on your plate.  你的盘子里还有很多食物。
She eats a bowl (= the contents of a bowl) of cereal every morning.  她每天早上吃一碗麦片。
He spooned the mush into the baby's open mouth.  他用杓舀了玉米粥喂到婴儿张开的嘴里。
a knife and fork.  一副刀叉UK noun countable
He drew/pulled a knife and stabbed her.  他拔出刀，刺中了她。noun countable (plural knives)
Brush your teeth twice a day.  每天刷两次牙。
She came downstairs after her shower, wrapped in a towel.  她淋浴后裹着毛巾走下楼来。
She bought me a box of prettily coloured soaps.  她买了一箱颜色漂亮的肥皂给我。
Directions: wet hair, apply shampoo and massage into a rich lather.  使用说明：润湿头发，涂上洗发精并轻揉头发至产生大量的泡沫。
You've spilled something down your shirt front.  你把甚么东西洒在衬衫前襟上了。
She was wearing jeans and a T-shirt.  她穿着牛仔裤和T恤。
Sunbathing bores the pants off me.  晒太阳真把我烦死了。plural noun
She put on a pair of shorts and a T-shirt.  她穿上短裤和T恤
Take the road which skirts (round) the village, not the one which goes through it.  沿村边的那条路走，不要走穿过村庄的那条路。
The queen, in full ceremonial dress, presided over the ceremony.  女王身着礼服盛装主持仪式。verb
Do your coat up, Joe, or you'll freeze.  扣好外套，乔，不然你会冻坏的。
The keys are in my jacket pocket.  锁匙在我的夹克口袋里。noun countable
Put a sweater on if you're cold.  如果你觉得冷就穿件毛线衫吧。
It's cold outside, wear a hoodie.  外面冷，穿件连帽衫。
These socks are warm and soft.  这双袜子又暖又软。
Take off your shoes at the door.  在门口把鞋脱掉。
This is me with my manager's hat on talking.  我这是以经理的身份在讲话。noun countable
Davis has 17 Scottish caps (= has played for Scotland 17 times).  戴维斯17次代表苏格兰参赛。
a knitted/woollen/silk scarf  针织／羊毛／丝绸围巾UK verb transitive    US for
Wear gloves before you go out.  出门之前戴上手套。
She fastened her belt tightly around her waist.  她把腰带束紧。
Could you tie this piece of string for me?  你能帮我把这个绳子打个结吗？

They're building a new school in the village.  他们正在村里建一座新学校。
They've got offices in Paris, London and Madrid.  他们在巴黎、伦敦和马德里都设有办事处。UK noun
a general/children's/maternity hospital  综合／儿童／妇产医院
We watched the joggers in the park.  我们在公园里看别人慢跑。
He's got an impressively large store of wine in his cellar.  他的酒窖里储存了数量惊人的葡萄酒。
I shop at the supermarket every weekend.  我每周末去超市买东西。
We had dinner at a new restaurant.  我们在一家新餐厅吃了晚饭。

a public/university library  公共／大学图书馆
The town no longer has a cinema.  小镇已不再有电影院了。
Our office is near the station.  我们的办事处在火车站附近。
an international airport  国际机场
We stayed in/at a hotel on the seafront.  我们住在一家滨海饭店。
The streets were strewn with rubbish after the carnival.  狂欢节过后，街上到处是垃圾。
We live on a busy/quiet road.  我们住在一条繁忙／僻静的公路边。
His left eye was heavily bandaged.  他的左眼被严严实实地包扎了起来。
You got three answers right and two wrong.  你答对了三道题，错了两道。
The National Front is an extremely right-wing political party in Britain.  民族阵线是英国极端右翼政党组织。
When you take the scissors, remember to put them back.  用完剪刀后，记着要放回原处。
Put those books up on the top shelf.  把那些书放到书架顶层。
Is this UKlift/ USelevator going down?  这部电梯是向下开的吗？
Did you clean the inside of the car?  你把车内擦干净了吗？

She only works in the mornings.  她只在上午工作。
It was a sunny afternoon.  那是一个阳光明媚的下午。
Thank you for such a lovely evening.  多谢你的款待，让我渡过了一个如此美妙的夜晚。
It gets cold at night.  夜间天气转凉。
January has 31 days.  一月份有31天。
We go to the cinema about once a week.  我们大约一周去看一次电影。
I'll be away for a month from mid-June to mid-July.  我会在6月中旬至7月中旬离开一个月。
Annette worked in Italy for two years.  安妮特在义大利工作了两年。
The exam lasted an hour and a half.  考试持续了一个半小时。
It takes me twenty minutes to get to work.  我上班路上要花20分钟。
What's the date today?  今天几号？
He rang yesterday while you were out.  昨天你外出时他打电话来了。
I've arranged to see Rachel tomorrow night.  我已经安排好明天晚上去看雷切尔。

We'll meet at eight on Tuesday.  我们周二八点见。
Did you say the meeting is on Wednesday?  你是说会议在星期三开吗？

They go to church on Sundays.  他们星期天去教堂。
Many bulbs bloom in (the) spring.  很多球茎植物春天开花。
We have breakfast on the balcony in (the) summer.  夏天，我们在阳台上吃早饭。
Leaves turn red and gold in autumn.  秋天树叶变成红色和金色。
Last winter we went skiing.  去年冬天我们去滑雪了。
We went into the house.  我们走进了那座房子。
Are you coming with me?  你跟我来吗？
He walks two kilometres to work every morning.  他每天早晨步行两公里去上班。
The sheep ran away/off in fright.  羊受惊跑掉了。
The children were jumping up and down with excitement.  孩子都兴奋地跳来跳去。
Do you eat meat?  你吃肉吗？
Would you like a drink of water/tea/juice?  你想喝点水／茶／果汁吗？
You'll find that your baby usually goes to sleep after a feed.  你会发现你的孩子通常吃饱后就睡了。
Did you wake at all during the night?  夜里你一点都没醒吗？
I've got so much work to do.  我有一大堆工作要做。
Next term we shall study plants and how they grow.  下个学期我们将学习植物及其生长过程。
He spent a pleasant afternoon reading (the newspaper/a book).  他一下午都在阅读（报纸／书），过得很开心。
Did you write off for tickets?  你写信索取门票了吗？ (wrote, written or old use writ)
What kind of music do you listen to ?  你听哪一类的音乐？
Would you mind speaking more slowly, please?  请你再说慢点，好吗？
We were just talking about Simon's new girlfriend.  我们刚才在谈论赛门的新女友。
Turn the light on so I can see.  打开灯，这样我才看得到。
Look! There's grandma.  看！祖母在那里。

We'll be selling the tickets at/for £50 each.  我们每张票将卖50英镑。
Has anything been taken (= stolen) ?  丢了甚么东西吗？

Scotland will be cloudy with wintry showers.  苏格兰将会转阴，且有寒冷的阵雨。

words.meaning: adj. 多风的，有风的；腹胀的；吹牛的
words.example: It was a windy night.  那是个多风的夜晚。
We've had a very snowy winter this year.  今年我们过了一个多雪的冬天。

words.meaning: adj. 有雾的；模糊的，朦胧的
words.example: a cold, foggy day  寒冷多雾的一天UK adjective
It's too hot in here, can we turn down the heating?  这里面太热了，我们能把暖气关小点吗？
My feet are so cold.  我的双脚冰冷。
Are you warm enough or do you want the fire on?  你暖不暖和，要不要生火？
It was a lovely cool evening.  那是个凉爽的夜晚。

The sky grew dark and it started to thunder.  天色变暗，开始打雷了。
That tree was struck by lightning.  那棵树被闪电击中了。
She looks so happy.  她看起来非常快乐。
I've just received some very sad news.  我刚刚得到一些令人伤心的消息。
